$comment: The app's web target, read by web-support's check-web-support.mjs and check-web-export.mjs. output repeats app.config.ts web.output; host says where the deployed site gets its response headers; smokeRoutes are the pages the export check opens in a browser, each with a testID the page must show; smokeLanguage opens the first one again in a right-to-left language (remove it when the app has one language); clientRoutes are dynamic routes a static export leaves to the host's rewrites.
